title: Alhambra and Nasrid Palaces
text: We were able to get tickets for the Alhambra, including the Nasrid Palaces, through this operator on relatively short notice. The communication was very friendly, everything worked well. We then received the tickets as a PDF file one day in advance. We were happy to accept that these were a bit more expensive than via the official Alhambra website in order to be able to visit the Alhambra on short notice.
author: Petra_H

title: It is legit, we got the tickets!!
text:
I can vouch for this. Tickets were sent in the Viator chat the night before.

Bring your passport because they scan it and only if they have it on the system they let you in.
author: alessandro_p

title: A highly recommended visit, with the Nasrid Palaces and the tourist train 😍
text: Everything was very good. It is important to be punctual when entering the Nasrid Palaces, since access is granted at a specific time. The tourist train was also very good: it makes a circular route of approximately one hour and you can get on as many times as you want. As the only drawback, that day there were many people waiting to take it, so we had to wait in quite a long line. In general, a highly recommended experience.
author: OLEKSII_N

title: Very good communication,...
text: Very good communication, they replied every time I wrote to them. Reasonable price in coparison with competitors
author: Petre_O

title: Goog choice for last minute Alhambra
text:
The tickets arrived successfully, although the time slot for the Nasrid Palaces was slightly different from the one we selected. However, this was clearly mentioned in the description when booking. The great thing is that you can enter the Alhambra complex from the morning and spend the time exploring other areas before your scheduled entry to the Nasrid Palaces.
The entire complex is huge, and you really need most of the day to see everything properly. The price was higher than on the official website, but our trip was a last-minute decision, so this was a good option for getting last-minute
author: Karolina_B

title: Last-minute chance to secure Alhambra (incl. Nasrid Palaces) tickets
text:
Since the tickets for the Alhambra were sold out weeks in advance, this was the only chance to still get tickets on short notice. The conditions were clear to us: no tour guide, significantly more expensive than regular tickets (though I find the price fair given the last-minute nature of the event), and a certain flexibility regarding entry into the Nasrid Palaces. There are completely different providers that sometimes want over €100 for admission, sometimes €250 with a tour guide. But I think something like that is a rip-off!

title: Viator site to avoid
text:
Do not use Viator, which promises you a meeting point where there is no one; furthermore, I paid for a self-guided tour and especially a tourist train ride, 2 activities that do not exist
Site that is very ambiguous in its excursions and programs 
I will never use this site again, which I personally consider dishonest
author: Freddy_T

title: We got the tickets!
text: We were unable to get tickets to the Alhambra but were able to get last minute tickets with Viatour. There were mixed reviews online but we had no trouble at all. They were responsive to my questions and the tickets were available the day before our booking.
author: Gail_S

title: Entry tickets for Nasrid palace and Alhambra, YES this is valid
text:
It is a nice loophole to get tickets (although about 3 times as expensive) for the Nasrid palace and the Alhambra. They are really worth a visit to see the inside!
Some pointers for the organization and other travelers:
- the digital ticket you receive is your entrance ticket for the Alhambra visit. You do NOT have to go anywhere else to get a ticket, and you do NOT have to be anywhere one hour beforehand. title: Above retail tickets but worth it!
text: If you missed out on getting Alhambra tickets, this is the way to go. While the price is 3.5x as much as retail, sometimes you gotta pay the resellers if you missed out. Time selection is limited so picked one that is closest to when you want to visit Alhambra. Tickets are emailed to you once available, be sure to bring your passports to be scanned as well.
